integrity.claim_domain: finite abelian groups of order k(k-1)+1 with k>=3 admitting a (v,k,1) difference set
integrity.proof_basis: finite Weyl orthogonality, unique-difference incidence, character sums and sharp amplitude pair-product inequality

scientific_limitations: The conditioning optimum is over informationally complete single-window Gabor systems whose generator has at most k nonzero coordinates; it does not compare denser supports.
The existence of a perfect difference set is assumed; classical Singer cyclic families supply infinitely many cases.
The conclusions concern complex-linear operator tomography rather than exact nonlinear pure-state noise constants.
The general Weyl operator-frame spectral reduction and classical Singer difference-set construction are existing results, not independently introduced here.
Independent mathematical and historical-priority audits have not been performed.
title: Sharp support-minimal Gabor tomography and amplitude rigidity on perfect difference sets
